visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short black hair and glasses, wearing a black button-up shirt, stands in front of a dark background featuring a large, soft-focus image of a ginger cat. He holds a black pen in his right hand and gestures frequently with both hands while speaking directly to the camera. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting his facial features and the texture of his shirt. (2) The scene cuts to a full-length shot of a museum exhibit featuring a realistic reconstruction of a female hominin, 'Lucy,' standing on a stone-like platform. She has dark, hairy skin and a primitive facial structure. The background shows a modern museum interior with display cases and soft overhead lighting. (3) Back to the speaker in the same studio setting, he continues his explanation with animated facial expressions, emphasizing points by moving his hands and the pen. (4) An image overlay appears on a white background showing a set of fossilized foot bones alongside a comparative anatomical drawing of a foot. Text at the bottom left attributes the image to the ASU Institute of Human Origins. (5) Returning to the speaker, he continues to address the audience. He shifts his weight slightly and uses the pen to point toward the screen as if indicating the previous image. (6) A detailed graphic displays numerous fossilized teeth and lower jaw fragments from multiple perspectives labeled 'a' to 'p'. The teeth are yellowed and set in stone-like matrix. (7) The speaker is shown again, maintaining a consistent posture and engagement level. The background cat image remains visible as he speaks. (8) A statistical box plot graph is presented, showing 'A. deyiremeda' and other species' carbon isotope data. The horizontal axis represents delta-13C enamel values with a color-coded legend for different species. (9) The man continues to speak, his mouth moving in synchronization with his speech. He looks directly into the lens, holding the pen near his chest. (10) Another graph appears, showing various hominin species compared across different dental metrics in a scatter plot format. (11) Final sequence of the speaker concluding his talk. He gestures broadly with both hands, his eyes moving as he delivers his final remarks before the video ends.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 搜尋泛科學院 全面解鎖Gemini. [Variety]: 露西可能不是人類祖母. (2) [Subtitle]: 大家好, 我不是志祺, 這也不是X調查. (3) [Subtitle]: 但今天要講一個懸宕了15年的懸案. (4) [Subtitle]: 關鍵證物是一隻找不到身體的腳. (5) [Subtitle]: 大家都很熟的「露西」(Lucy)是「阿法南猿」. (6) [Subtitle]: 在300多萬年前的東非蹓躂. (7) [Subtitle]: 如果是人類祖母的話, 得加上16萬個「曾」. (8) [Subtitle]: 但在2009年, 科學家在衣索比亞的Burtele地區. (9) [Subtitle]: 挖到了一樣不得了的東西. (10) [Subtitle]: 一塊340萬年前的腳掌化石. [Logo]: 來源：ASU Institute of Human Origins. [Slogan]: BRT-VP-2/73. (11) [Subtitle]: 這隻腳簡直就是特級咒物啊. (12) [Subtitle]: 因為露西的腳早就演化成適合在地面走路, 大拇指是併攏的. (13) [Subtitle]: 但這隻腳骨卻保留了強大的遠古力量. (14) [Subtitle]: 它的大拇指竟然還可以「對握」, 就像猩猩一樣. (15) [Subtitle]: 顯然擁有強大的爬樹能力. (16) [Subtitle]: 由美國亞利桑那州立大學人類起源研究所的. (17) [Subtitle]: 海爾-塞拉西(Yohannes Haile-Selassie)領軍的團隊. (18) [Subtitle]: 握著這根獨特的腳骨, 卻也苦於只有腳骨. (19) [Subtitle]: 現場找不到頭骨、沒有牙齒. (20) [Subtitle]: 只好把它封印在倉庫裡長達15年. (21) [Subtitle]: 好在沒有人把它吃了. (22) [Subtitle]: 原本以為這故事就這麼爛尾了, 但就在最近. (23) [Subtitle]: 同團隊竟然在發現腳掌的「同一個地層」. (24) [Subtitle]: 只差幾百公尺的地方, 挖出了一批新的牙齒和下顎骨化石. (25) [Subtitle]: 研究剛發表在《Nature》上. (26) [Subtitle]: 這下連載重啟啊, 科學家要讓它受肉重生. (27) [Subtitle]: 但不搞咒術, 搞技術. (28) [Subtitle]: 他們祭出「工業級顯微電腦斷層掃描」(Micro-CT). (29) [Subtitle]: 看穿骨頭內部, 發現這副下顎骨. (30) [Subtitle]: 少了一個露西族群特有的標記, 叫做「外側孔洞」(lateral corpus hollow). (31) [Subtitle]: 而且犬齒內部的構造也跟露西完全不同. (32) [Subtitle]: 根據這些解剖學上的特徵, 科學家將這些牙齒. (33) [Subtitle]: 歸屬於2015年才被命名的新物種「近親南猿」(Australopithecus deyiremeda). (34) [Subtitle]: 為什麼? 因為同一個地點、同一個時間層, 只有這一種, 沒有其他古猿. (35) [Subtitle]: 但這也代表在340萬年前, 露西並不是唯一的霸主. (36) [Subtitle]: 她有群鄰居就住在五公里外. (37) [Subtitle]: 而且這個鄰居的生活習慣跟她截然不同. (38) [Subtitle]: 科學家驗了牙齒法瑯質的「碳同位素」. (39) [Subtitle]: 發現這位「近親南猿」, 是位堅持只吃C3植物的「森林系」饕客. (40) [Subtitle]: 專吃樹葉跟果實. (41) [Subtitle]: 而住在旁邊的露西, 則是C3加C4通吃, 連草原上的草都吃. (42) [Subtitle]: 這兩個物種雖然住得蠻近, 但因為你吃你的樹, 我走我的路. (43) [Subtitle]: 所以沒有互相滅絕. (44) [Subtitle]: 但這也代表, 露西所屬的阿法南猿, 說不定根本不是我們的直系祖先. (45) [Subtitle]: 這個還留著爬樹外掛的近親南猿, 搞不好更接近我們祖先原型的樣子. (46) [Subtitle]: 不過西班牙國家人類演化研究中心的. (47) [Subtitle]: 古人類學家萊斯利·盧斯科(Leslea Hlusko)不買單. (48) [Subtitle]: 她認為這所謂的「近親南猿」, 牙齒特徵剛好介於更老的湖畔南猿跟阿法南猿之間. (49) [Subtitle]: 總不能截了一張皮卡丘進化成雷丘中間發光的圖. (50) [Subtitle]: 然後說這是一隻全新的寶可夢叫起丘吧. (51) [Subtitle]: 她懷疑這只是演化過程中的過渡階段. (52) [Subtitle]: 甚至可能只是露西族群裡長得比較怪、腳比較像猩猩的個體. (53) [Subtitle]: 但研究團隊不是吃素的, 雖然近親南猿是吃素的. (54) [Subtitle]: 他們回說, 如果是露西族群裡的變異個體. (55) [Subtitle]: 沒道理會集體堅持只吃森林特餐(C3). (56) [Subtitle]: 而其他人吃雜食自助餐. (57) [Subtitle]: 這種連飲食文化都完全不同的現象, 通常就是兩個物種才有的生殖隔離. (58) [Subtitle]: 這場認祖歸宗的大戲還沒演完. (59) [Subtitle]: 露西真的是我們所有人的直系阿嬤嗎? 還是只是遠房阿姨呢? (60) [Subtitle]: 宿儺是虎杖的伯公嗎? 眷屬是虎杖的媽媽嗎? 算了隨便啦.
